title: denial_reason_result.json -- insurer's stated position, extracted and classified v0.2
description: Extracts denial/reduction/non-payment reasons from an insurer-response document and classifies each against the R-code taxonomy. Produced by denial-response, which is dependency-triggered (runs whenever a flagged insurer-response document's processed text exists) rather than phase-gated -- see pipeline.md. The loss-adjuster-reviewed frequency tier is fixed taxonomy metadata in common_component_output.schema.json's taxonomy_code.x-codebook; it is deliberately not copied into each case result or used as confidence. Judgment-type output; include the safety fields (source_grounded etc.) from common_component_output.schema.json. v0.2: carries upstream_policy_snapshot -- the policy-layer digest set this result was derived from. Optional in the schema because an artifact that references no policy clause has nothing to bind to; the DAO makes it mandatory the moment a clause reference exists, and refuses a stale one.

denial_reasons.description: Extracted reasons. Empty array means no denial/reduction found.

upstream_policy_snapshot.description: The policy-layer snapshot this artifact was derived from (Part 11I). Required whenever the artifact carries at least one policy reference: a downstream result is an assertion about what the policy layer said when it was written, so it records which bytes it read. The DAO recomputes this at write time and refuses a mismatch; `dao.py policy-snapshot` prints the current value. Per-document digests cover the normalized contract, boundary inventory, reference tables, processed source text, manifest entry (page_map included) and governing parent coverage -- the same set the document's audit binds to.

reason_type.description: denial=non-payment, reduction=reduced payout, partial_payment=partial payout, document_request=additional documents requested

taxonomy_label.description: R-code display label, in Korean. e.g. 기왕증 / 기존 질환 기여도

candidate_codes.description: Top-3 candidate R-codes (descending confidence, first entry matches taxonomy_code). Used for the denial-reason Top-3 agreement metric.

insurer_claim_summary.description: Summary of the insurer's position. Use hedged, non-definitive phrasing (see the forbidden-expression guide in pipeline.md).

reduction_rate.description: Reduction rate. null if not applicable.

reduction_amount.description: Reduction amount (KRW). null if not stated in the source.

policy_matches.description: Policy clauses this denial reason was matched to (denial-response.md step 5). Empty array if no matching clause could be found -- record why in warnings.

relevance_note.description: Why this clause was matched to this reason, if not self-evident.
